heading: ### Round-21 gate/probe registry — finite environment differential

findings.quote: - F1: “`tools/env-diff.py` | probe | `python3 tools/env-diff.py --contract .ufo/evidence/round-21/c2-contract.json --out /tmp/tameshi-f5.json`” — the `--out` pathname in the purported runnable entry is hard-coded to `/tmp/tameshi-f5.json`, but the round-52 scratch directive explicitly prohibits writing there beyond small files; it is not a valid reusable invocation under the current required workflow. Command: `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin show 7ff81a5b0ab0fbaefd68cf4ef9dcfe687a6d7135:SKILL.md | sed -n '1964,2103p'`.
findings.skill_statement: The registry's env-diff entry command writes its receipt to /tmp/tameshi-f5.json.

findings.quote: - F2: “`tools/env-diff.py` | probe | ...” write-scope claim “isolated `/tmp/tameshi-r21-envdiff.*`” is stale: CAND1 `tools/env-diff.py` calls `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="tameshi-r21-envdiff.", dir="/tmp")` (around line 60); the declared scratch rule requires `/fast/scratch/...` and limits writes under `/tmp`. Command: `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin show 7ff81a5b0ab0fbaefd68cf4ef9dcfe687a6d7135:tools/env-diff.py | rg -n 'TemporaryDirectory|dir="/tmp"'`.
